About us

A trusted name for banquets in Rawalpindi

For over two decades, City Marriage Hall has been hosting the most important days in the lives of Rawalpindi families. Located on Asghar Mall Road near TB Hospital, our halls combine comfortable seating, attentive staff and a team of organizers who handle the details for you.

  • Spacious halls with comfortable guest seating
  • Cooperative, experienced event organizers
  • Good quality at a reasonable budget
  • Separate game room to keep children happy
